يقتطفا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَطِفَا (yaqtaṭifā) /jaq.ta.tˤi.faː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# يُقْتَطَفَا (yuqtaṭafā) /juq.ta.tˤa.faː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
